_comment: Placeholders only. Configure provider credentials locally using TrueForge or the secure helper; never save real keys here. This is a checklist, not an import manifest.
credentialSetup: Configure Google Gemini provider in TrueForge for the primary and inline models. For the fallback provider (NVIDIA NIM), set FALLBACK_BASE_URL (https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1), FALLBACK_MODEL (e.g. meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct) and FALLBACK_API_KEY, then run node scripts/configure-fallback.cjs. Groq is optional. Credentials are stored by TrueForge, not in this file.
